findings.issue: The sentence tells the reader what the phone app shows, but uses «无响应» while the phone app's own zh-CN label for this state is «未响应» (relay.chrome.session.subtitle.not_answering). A user comparing the report with the phone screen sees two different words.
findings.fix: Use «未响应»: «…手机应用可能会将此电脑显示为未响应。» / «手机访问服务正在运行但未响应；手机应用会将此电脑显示为未响应。…»

findings.issue: Translator question 6: «休眠» is the zh-CN OS term for Hibernate (Sleep is «睡眠» on both Windows and macOS) and this catalogue set already uses «休眠» for “dormant” (tui.app.parked.dormant). «显示为休眠» is understood, but «睡眠» is the precise everyday word for a computer that is asleep.
findings.fix: «…在服务启动前，手机应用会将此电脑显示为睡眠状态。» — or whatever exact word the phone app's zh-CN UI shows for this state (that catalogue is outside this repo and was not checked).

findings.issue: Translator question 3: no final 。. The style guide permits omitting 。 on short statuses, so this is acceptable; but doctor.text() prints one summary per line and every other check summary in this namespace ends in 。, so the report mixes both.
findings.fix: Optional: «已登录Radient。» / «未登录Radient。» for consistency within the report.

findings.issue: «响应用时{ms}毫秒» briefly parses as «响/应用/时» (应用 = app) in sentences that also say «手机应用».

translator_questions_answered: Q3 (no final 。 on login.ok/missing): acceptable per style guide, nit ZH-D3 for consistency. Q6 (asleep): «休眠» = Hibernate in zh-CN OS vocabulary — minor ZH-D2, suggest «睡眠». Q1/Q2/Q4/Q5 concern other locales.
